500W Power Motor: The K14 electric bike for adults is powered by a 500W brushless motor, reaching a top speed of 22 mph,Max Range 35Miles(Pedal-Assist).

Long Range Removable Battery: K14 Folding E-Bike Built-in 48V 10.4Ah Removable Battery, provide great performance after one charging to power your ride for up to 35 miles (PAS mode), perfect for daily commuting, short travel.

3 Riding Modes:K14 Adults and Teens Electric bike customize your ride with three riding modes: pure electric mode, motor-assisted mode, and pedal Assist mode.

Foldable & Portable: Electric Bicycle for Women & Men features a foldable design, easily folding down to 28*23 inches for stress-free storage and transport.

Safe and Comfortable Riding:The 14″ electric bicycles with front and rear double disc brakes for sensitive braking, adjustable seat & handlebar and LED display, rear reflector which makes it safer to ride in both day and night, with a high safety coefficient
